metadata.body:
# PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

Blueprint for clio-agent. The numeric work lives in plain scripts in this
repository so it can run on PBS compute nodes without an LLM:

- `agent/manifest.py`: list the DASV records on `s3://nrel-pds-porotomo/` and sample them.
- `agent/detect.py`: per-record detector (common-mode removal, 10-150 Hz band-pass, median STA/LTA).
- `agent/pbs/submit.sh`: submit the distributed detection plus aggregation job to Aurora.
- `agent/hazard.py`: anomaly z-scores, event catalogue, pumping volumes, seismogenic index, probabilities.

The experts orchestrate those scripts, inspect files, and explain results. They
never make up numbers. Every figure they report comes from `summary.json` or a
tool result.

Install by linking this directory into `~/.config/clio-agent/agent-blueprints/`.

agent_blueprint.name: PoroTomo IS (bench: digest)

session.title: porotomo-is-digest: Report the headline results of the agent

answer:
Headline results of the agent run in /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (read-only report from summary.json, generated 2026-11-15T16:02:33+00:00; no PBS jobs submitted, hazard.py not run):

SCOPE / RECORDS ANALYSED
- Records analysed: 759 (by_status: {"ok": 759}), stride 20 (every 20th record, i.e. one per ~10 min, not 20 s), first record 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z, last 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z; sampled_fraction_of_time = 0.03314; mean 2003.99 ms per record.
- Note: detect.log pre-retry showed 753 ok + 6 download_failed; summary.json reflects the post-retry state of 759 ok (retry_manifest.txt).

ANOMALIES AND DAS DETECTIONS
- Anomalous records: 57 at z_threshold = 5.0; top zmax = 30.92 at 2016-03-23T20:50:17Z (driver: max_sta_lta).
- DAS detections: n = 62 events; scaled to full observation time = 1870.77; records_with_events = 53; relative b = 0.9849352475487246; relative mc = -0.8492463451632817; n_above_mc = 34.

SEISMOGENIC INDEX Sigma (hazard_catalog_based) and P(Mw>=5.5) per year at the observed rate, per b scenario:
- b = 1.0: Sigma = -5.448901270028832; P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.00011982478978644906 (~1.20e-4)
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.3193012700288325; P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.004921548824626587 (~4.92e-3)
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.280901270028833; P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.014735103451029574 (~1.47e-2)
(For reference, P over the observed volume M>=5.5: b=1.0 = 5.24e-6; b=0.73 = 2.16e-4; b=0.65 = 6.48e-4.)

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (hazard_das_upper_bound)
- b_used = 0.9849352475487246 (DAS relative-magnitude Aki MLE); Sigma = -2.698279919032152; P(Mw>=5.5) per year at observed rate = 0.07842182774171746 (~7.84e-2); over observed volume = 0.0024076054468051833.
- Caveat: this bound over-counts because every DAS detection is treated as an event at or above the catalogue minimum magnitude, using uncalibrated (relative) magnitudes.

CALIBRATED vs UPPER BOUND
- CALIBRATED: the hazard_catalog_based probabilities (the per-b P(Mw>=5.5)/yr and Sigma above), based on the LBNL/NCEDC March 2016 catalogue (GDR 859; n=5, mc=-0.48, mag_max=0.07, all calibrated ML), with pumping from GDR 917 corrected deployment data. These are the calibrated values to quote for a Pohang-like (Mw>=5.5) earthquake likelihood.
- UPPER BOUND (uncalibrated): the DAS-based hazard_das_upper_bound (P/yr = 0.0784) is a DAS-based upper bound with uncalibrated magnitudes and must be quoted only with that caveat; it is NOT the calibrated probability.

ASSUMPTIONS EACH RESTS ON
- Catalog-based Sigma/P: calibrated local magnitudes from GDR 859 (LBNL/NCEDC, March 2016), Gutenberg-Richter fit with the chosen b scenario (1.0 / 0.73 / 0.65), rates scaled to the observed DAS rate; assumes the catalogue completeness mc=-0.48 and that the March 2016 LBNL catalogue is representative.
- DAS upper bound: assumes every one of the 62 DAS detections counts as an event >= catalogue mc with relative (uncalibrated) magnitudes and Aki-MLE b=0.9849, hence a deliberate over-count; read-only run used stride-20 sampling (3.31% of the time window), so full-time scaling (x~30) is applied to rates.
